verses.text: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by God's will, and from our brother Timothy.
We write to God's holy people in Colossae, the faithful brothers and sisters in Christ. Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you.
We have heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love you have for all God's people.
Your faith and love come from the hope that is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope in the true message, the Good News
that came to you. All over the world this Good News is bearing fruit and growing. It has been doing the same among you, since the day you heard it and truly understood God's grace.
You learnt it from Epaphras, our dear fellow servant. He is a faithful servant of Christ for your sake.
He also told us about your love in the Spirit.
So since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you. We ask God to fill you with the knowledge of what he wants, with all the wisdom and understanding the Spirit gives.
Then you will live a life worthy of the Lord and please him in every way. You will bear fruit in every good work, and grow in knowing God.
We pray that you will be made strong with all power, by his glorious might. Then you will keep going and be patient with joy.
And you will give thanks to the Father. He has made you fit to share in the inheritance of his holy people in the kingdom of light.
He has rescued us from the power of darkness. He has brought us into the Kingdom of the Son he loves.
In his Son we are set free, and our sins are forgiven.
The Son is the image of the God we cannot see. He is first and above all creation.
Everything was created by him, in heaven and on earth, things we can see and things we cannot see, whether thrones or powers or rulers or authorities. Everything was created through him and for him.
He existed before everything, and in him everything holds together.
He is the head of the body, the church. He is the beginning, and the first to rise from the dead, so that he would be first in everything.
God was pleased to have all his fullness live in him.
Through him God was pleased to bring everything back to himself, things on earth and things in heaven. He made peace through Christ's blood, shed on the cross.
Once you were far from God. You were his enemies in your minds, because of the evil things you did.
But now he has brought you back to himself through Christ's death in his human body. He did this to bring you before him holy, without fault, and free from blame.

But you must keep going in your faith, firm and steady. Do not move away from the hope of the Good News you heard. It has been preached to every creature under heaven, and I, Paul, have become its servant.
Now I am glad to suffer for you. In my own body I am adding to what is still lacking in Christ's sufferings, for the sake of his body, the church.
I became the church's servant by the task God gave me, to tell you the whole message of God.
It is the secret that was hidden for ages and generations. But now God has shown it to his holy people.
God chose to make known to them the glorious riches of this secret among the Gentiles. The secret is this: Christ in you, the hope of glory.
We preach about Christ. We warn and teach everyone with all wisdom, so that we can bring everyone to God, mature in Christ.
To do this I work hard and struggle, with all the energy that Christ so powerfully gives me.
